title: Netflix TV v1.4.5
changelog: Added Automatic Next Episode autoplay for TV Series and Anime with Netflix-style 10s post-play countdown overlay and TV remote control (OK: Play Now, Back: Cancel)
Added Virtual TV Cursor & Native Touch Engine enabling Android TV remotes to interact with embedded server player buttons (FrameX Backup player, server dropdowns, video controls)
Upgraded streaming server architecture with active VidLink, 2Embed, and VidSrc endpoints resolving titles like The Good Lawyer
Added 'Server Remote' mode toggle to bottom player controls with high-visibility cursor and guidance HUD
Enabled D-pad spatial velocity acceleration and boundary-clamped cursor targeting
Synthesized OS-level MotionEvent touch down/up events penetrating cross-origin iframe sandboxes
